mapper.select: select from lab_hazard h where h.id=#{hazardId} and h.del_flag='0'
select from lab_hazard h where h.id=#{hazardId} and h.del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_hazard h where h.source_item_id=#{sourceItemId} and h.del_flag='0' limit 1
select id from lab_device where laboratory_id=#{laboratoryId} and del_flag='0' order by id

select h.id from lab_hazard h join lab_device d on d.id=#{deviceId} and d.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.severity='MAJOR' and h.status in ('PENDING_RECTIFICATION','RECTIFYING','PENDING_REVIEW') and ((h.target_type='DEVICE' and h.target_id=d.id) or (h.target_type='LABORATORY' and h.target_id=d.laboratory_id)) order by h.id for update
mapper.update: update lab_hazard set status=#{target},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 where id=#{hazardId} and status=#{expected} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select from lab_hazard h where h.deadline < #{now} and h.status <> 'CLOSED' and h.overdue_flag='0' and h.del_flag='0' order by h.id limit #{limit} for update
mapper.update: update lab_hazard set overdue_flag='1', overdue_set_at=#{now}, overdue_event_version=overdue_event_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=#{now}, version=version+1 where id=#{hazardId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and overdue_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select from lab_hazard h where h.overdue_flag='1' and h.overdue_set_at is not null and h.overdue_event_version > 0 and h.del_flag='0' and ((h.owner_id is not null and not exists ( select 1 from lab_message_delivery n where n.dedupe_key=cast(concat('overdue:hazard:',h.id,':',h.overdue_event_version,':',h.owner_id) as binary) )) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_user u on u.user_id=ur.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='lab_safety_officer' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' join lab_laboratory l on l.id=case when h.target_type='LABORATORY' then h.target_id else (select d.laboratory_id from lab_device d where d.id=h.target_id and d.del_flag='0') end and l.del_flag='0' where (r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and exists (select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=r.role_id and rd.dept_id=l.dept_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and l.dept_id=u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope='4' and exists (select 1 from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=l.dept_id and sd.status='0' and sd.del_flag='0' and (sd.dept_id=u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id,sd.ancestors)>0))) or (r.data_scope='5' and l.manager_id=u.user_id)) and not exists (select 1 from lab_message_delivery n where n.dedupe_key=cast(concat('overdue:hazard:',h.id,':',h.overdue_event_version,':',u.user_id) as binary)) )) order by h.id limit #{limit}
select count(1) from lab_usage_record where device_id=#{deviceId} and returned_at is null and del_flag='0'
select count(1) from lab_repair_order where device_id=#{deviceId} and status in ('WAIT_ASSIGN','WAIT_REPAIR','IN_PROGRESS','WAIT_ACCEPTANCE') and del_flag='0'
